chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a Moroccan man about 30, short black hair, neat short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a white stripe across the chest and dark jeans
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a Moroccan woman about 27, wearing a lilac headscarf, a long teal embroidered house kaftan and small gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. In a cosy Moroccan bedroom at night, SALMA is caught mid-act secretly slipping a small folded paper amulet tied with red thread inside her husband's pillowcase, glancing nervously over her shoulder, startled. Seen from the bedroom doorway, head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. In the same Moroccan bedroom, YOUSSEF stands holding up several small folded paper amulets tied with red thread in his open palm, confronting SALMA with a shocked angry face; SALMA freezes, eyes wide. Both faces visible, medium shot, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. Close medium shot of SALMA stammering, very embarrassed, eyes down, fidgeting with the end of her headscarf, in a Moroccan bedroom with a carved wooden wardrobe behind her. Face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. In a Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas, SALMA shrugs and explains with open hands as if it is normal, while YOUSSEF listens in disbelief, hand on his forehead. Both faces visible, medium shot, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. YOUSSEF firmly takes off his wedding ring and places it on a small round wooden table, decided and serious; SALMA in the background reaches out, pleading. Moroccan living room. Both faces visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. At night in a dim Moroccan bedroom, YOUSSEF lies awake in bed with wide suspicious eyes, staring sideways at SALMA who sleeps peacefully next to him; moonlight from the window. Both faces visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon, vertical. YOUSSEF sits tired and drained on a bench in a busy Moroccan family court corridor, holding a thick stack of paperwork and folders, looking exhausted. Face visible, centred. No text.
